entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: ¶But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, you have no need that I should write to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: For you yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: For when they say, "Peace and safety!" then sudden destruction comes upon them, as labor pains upon a pregnant woman. And they shall not escape.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, so that this Day should overtake you as a thief.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: You are all sons of light and sons of the day. We are not of the night nor of darkness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: ¶Therefore let us not sleep, as others [do], but let us watch and be sober.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk are drunk at night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us who are of the day be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and [as] a helmet the hope of salvation.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: who died for us, that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with Him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: ¶Therefore comfort each other and edify one another, just as you also are doing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: And we urge you, brethren, to recognize those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn those who are unruly, comfort the fainthearted, uphold the weak, be patient with all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: See that no one renders evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is good both for yourselves and for all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: ¶Rejoice always,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: pray without ceasing,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: in everything give thanks; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Do not quench the Spirit.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: Do not despise prophecies.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: Test all things; hold fast what is good.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: Abstain from every form of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: ¶Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely; and may your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: He who calls you [is] faithful, who also will do [it].

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brethren, pray for us.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brethren.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.
